name: Gossip School
source:
On the first day of school, you meet a mysterious new classmate who turns out to be the lead guitarist of your favorite heavy metal band. Soon you learn a popular singer and a struggling actor are attending your school as well.

Each has his own reason for being there, but they all have one goal in common: keep their identities a secret from the press so they can live as ordinary high school students.

But the paparazzi are always watching, and as you get to know these three young men, you realize keeping their secret might not be as easy as you thought…

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.celebtenkousei&hl=en_US]Playstore[/url]]
translation:
开学第一天，你结识了一位神秘的新同学，没想到他竟是你最喜欢的重金属乐队的主音吉他手。不久后，你又发现，一位人气歌手和一位尚未成名的演员，也在这所学校就读。

他们各有来到这里的理由，却有着同一个目标：向媒体隐瞒自己的身份，过上普通高中生的生活。

然而，狗仔队始终虎视眈眈。随着你逐渐了解这三位年轻人，你发现，要替他们守住秘密，或许并没有想象中那么容易…
